evaluation.selection_rationale: Units selected to cover prioritized headline financial performance and changes, sales/presales activity, handovers, major strategic/capital events (IPO, dividends, acquisitions), liquidity/financing position, and forward outlook. Each represents an independently omittable material theme supported directly by source text; avoided boilerplate and minor details; total of 9 units within 6-10 target.
